notes.title: Update 7 (Achievements, and more!)
notes.content: [h2]Achievements[/h2][p][/p][p]There are now 10 new achievements for you to unlock, giving you a little extra challenge and some fun goals to reach. Some of the achievements are visible from the start, and others are secrets![/p][p][/p][h2]Steam Deck improvements[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/9771491f72ec2fdca433dac156463aeaf54a0338.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Many changes have been made to improve compatibility with Steam Deck. Controller icons are more accurate, the interface is bigger (by default) and text has been adjusted. It's currently being tested by Steam and hopefully the game will reach Steam Deck Verified status soon![/p][p][/p][h2]Tutorial[/h2][p][/p][p]The tutorial has been completely overhauled and now guides you through more of the basics. It shows you how to rotate objects, how to move them up and down, and how to adjust the size of your room.[/p][p][/p][h2]New items[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/beb880d79d1474bc279718e3272189aee5bd8cea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Just like the other updates, this one also brings in new items. Everything here was kindly suggested by the community and includes instruments, crystals, teapots and new roof windows![/p][p][/p][p]Your suggestions help make the game better, thank you for sharing them! Here is a full list of changes:[/p][p][/p][p][b]New features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 10 new Steam Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the tutorial (now teaches selection, rotation, room resizing & more)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes & improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 5 new sample objects (made by Silthulhu)[/p][/*][*][p]Added loading screen when preparing Steam Workshop items[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Workshop items are no longer reloaded when returning to the title screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added new animation and sound when downloading or uploading to Steam Workshop[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Workshop uploads now include a list of custom objects used[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the maximum scale from 2× to 3×[/p][/*][*][p]Increased interface size on Steam Deck; removed option to shrink[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted custom mode interface to prevent overlapping elements[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the colors of the offset arrows to match the gizmo in custom mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added dividers to toolbar menus[/p][/*][*][p]Improved toolbar icons[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips to toolbar menu[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the round bathtub object[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added boundaries for scaling objects via hotkeys[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with tracking completed requests[/p][/*][*][p]Correct input glyphs now display on Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input glyph sizing on Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed settings not applying in custom mode[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New items[/b][/p][list][*][p]4× Flat roof window (Construction)[/p][/*][*][p]Tea pot (Food)[/p][/*][*][p]Tea kettle (Food)[/p][/*][*][p]Chimney top (Fireplaces)[/p][/*][*][p]Chimney top narrow (Fireplaces)[/p][/*][*][p]Moon shape (Shapes, custom mode)[/p][/*][*][p]Moustache shape (Shapes, custom mode)[/p][/*][*][p]Crystal (Accessories)[/p][/*][*][p]Crystal quartz (Accessories)[/p][/*][*][p]Crystal salt (Lamps)[/p][/*][*][p]Guitar acoustic (Accessories)[/p][/*][*][p]Guitar electric (Accessories)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 6 (Hiding & locking, and more!)
notes.content: [h2]Hiding & locking[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/9a80e52619da81e928a43613a5e63845c57e9b49.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can now hide or lock objects. Click the "hide" icon to make objects temporarily invisible, then restore them using the hotkey (CTRL + H) or the button in the top right. Similarly, you can lock objects to prevent selecting them until they're unlocked. Both features work in the diorama creator and the object creator.[/p][p][/p][h2]Sample objects[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/bba050ee443d595702511d3beb588376a643a76a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You’ll now see a set of sample objects in the object creator. They’re useful for building things like tables, sofas, or chairs. These samples were created by community member Silthulhu, with more on the way![/p][p][/p][h2]New items[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/41af1db3b39ee6ad7d031537577fbf363fe4369c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update also introduces new items of which most in a Japanese style. It includes shoji doors/windows, tatami mats, chabudai, kotatsu and more![/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback and comments are invaluable to improving the game, thank you for sending them! Here's the full changelog:[/p][p][/p][p][b]New features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Press TAB (or START on gamepad/Steam Deck) to toggle the interface[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to hide objects (press H to hide, press CTRL + H to unhide all)[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to lock objects (press L to lock, press CTRL + L to unlock all)[/p][/*][*][p]Sample objects added to the object editor[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes & improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed available save slot pages from 10 to 25[/p][/*][*][p]Added "New" button to object editor[/p][/*][*][p]Rearranged menu items in object editor[/p][/*][*][p]Added progress display on requests screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to set the gamepad sensitivity[/p][/*][*][p]Rearranged the options menu[/p][/*][*][p]Changed "Back to menu" button after completing request to a notification[/p][/*][*][p]Small improvements to icons[/p][/*][*][p]Added sample chashitsu made by Silthulhu[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect color swatches for custom objects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed button on CRT monitor model[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed small issue when selecting reference guide in editor[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New items[/b][/p][list][*][p]2× Bookcases with arches (Cabinets)[/p][/*][*][p]2× Bookcase lights (Lamps & Fans)[/p][/*][*][p]4× Shoji doors/windows (Doors)[/p][/*][*][p]2× Tatami mats (Carpets)[/p][/*][*][p]6× Lanterns (Lamps & Fans)[/p][/*][*][p]1× Chabudai (Tables)[/p][/*][*][p]1× Kotatsu (Tables)[/p][/*][*][p]1× Zaisu (Chairs)[/p][/*][*][p]1× Sushi (Food)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 5 (Boats, and more!)
notes.content: [h2]Boats[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/6780ec59bda6939fc0b80b183f23816fb94e08e3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can now decorate boats! You'll be able to customize the bow, the stern and the mast. There's also a brand new request involving boats. Just select the boat to the south of the island to get started![/p][p][/p][h2]Windows[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/0984dd83fd75a6fc5f19b6a7daf9288892505e06.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]New attic-style windows have been added! Just set the wall height to low, and you’ll be able to place them (you'll find them in the "Construction" category). There are both straight and curved versions to choose from![/p][p][/p][h2]New items[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/12770518173bdd833f1bf2e536ca045f58eb3c57.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There's new windows, but also a lot of new objects to use while creating custom objects. Like ornamental corners, shapes and new sphere types.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for sending your feedback and comments! It's truly a joy to be able to grant the wishes of the community and add new features to the game. Here's the full changelog:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes & improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]“Samples” pages limited to maximum available[/p][/*][*][p]“Workshop” pages set to unlimited[/p][/*][*][p]Select any part of the camper or boat to customize[/p][/*][*][p]Editor maximum level height increased to 20[/p][/*][*][p]Editor level height now respects snapping settings[/p][/*][*][p]Improved environment transparency[/p][/*][*][p]Updated game shortcut icon[/p][/*][*][p]Updated fireflies icon[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected camera panning speed with gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved palm trees clipping into larger rooms[/p][/*][*][p]Effects now render correctly behind glass[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed loading Workshop dioramas from the title screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed colors for cabinet, and carpet tile[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing back side for hanging photographs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rendering of guidelines in editor[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New items[/b][/p][list][*][p]3× Roof window (Construction)[/p][/*][*][p]3× Roof window curved (Construction)[/p][/*][*][p]3× Roof window steep (Construction)[/p][/*][*][p]Unlockable item for completing new request (Accessories)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New items (Editor)[/b][/p][list][*][p]12× Ornamental corners (Corners, a new category)[/p][/*][*][p]14× Flat shapes (Shapes, a new category)[/p][/*][*][p]Rounded triangle (Primitives)[/p][/*][*][p]Sphere with bottom squashed A (Primitives)[/p][/*][*][p]Sphere with bottom squashed B (Primitives)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 4 (360° rotation, and more!)
notes.content: [p]It's [b]MakeRoom Monday[/b]! I'm super excited to share the latest update with you. As always, it contains a few things that were often requested by you, the community! Let's see what's new...[/p][p][/p][h2]Full 360° rotation[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/c6241cfad253fd124ad2d532d716af13c87acdb4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I've seen many requests for full 360 degree rotation so now you can spin your room all the way around. Even the back is yours to decorate! What little surprises will you tuck away? 👀[/p][p][/p][h2]Size references[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/52faa64797dacb16aa1d22912fb5fc930529655e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Some of you shared that it can be tricky to tell how big furniture is when making custom objects. I totally get that! That's why you can now pick different size guides. Just choose one at the top of the screen and a handy guide will appear to help you size things up![/p][p][/p][h2]New items[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/f74a2e6146e8b65549697c9d915637b46e8bc9e9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And of course, this update brings plenty of new items. Like all kinds of cat shelves, pet-themed rugs, and cabinets in new sizes! But that's not all, check out the full changelog below. As always, I'd love to see your reviews, ideas or feedback. See you again next week![/p][p][/p][p][b]New features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Full 360° rotation[/p][/*][*][p]Size reference objects in custom mode[/p][/*][*][p]Color description tooltips for swatches [i](accessibility)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Color description for color wheel selections [i](accessibility)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]3× New wall options[/p][/*][*][p]2× New floor options[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes & improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] Rotate entire model[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] Model shifting now respects snap setting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] Workshop upload button now shows “Update” when modifying existing files[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] On-screen message when editing existing files[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] Item loading speed improved by 10%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] Larger object thumbnails[/p][/*][*][p]Refined wall shape icons[/p][/*][*][p]Updated and improved Dutch translation[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Workshop uploads for custom objects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed folder icon in photography mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect colors on toothpaste model[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect colors on folded towel model[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New items[/b][/p][list][*][p]4× Single drawer side table variants (Cabinets)[/p][/*][*][p]4× Lower bookcase variants (Cabinets)[/p][/*][*][p]Cat shelf (Pets)[/p][/*][*][p]Cat shelf bed (Pets)[/p][/*][*][p]Cat shelf bed wide (Pets)[/p][/*][*][p]Cat shelf bed rectangle (Pets)[/p][/*][*][p]Cat shelf bed round (Pets)[/p][/*][*][p]Cat shelf box (Pets)[/p][/*][*][p]Cat shelf steps (Pets)[/p][/*][*][p]Pet door (Pets)[/p][/*][*][p]Dog bone (Carpets)[/p][/*][*][p]Cat paw (Carpets)[/p][/*][*][p]Kitchen paper stack (Food)[/p][/*][*][p]Rounded window closed (Windows)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 3 (3D exporting, and more!)
notes.content: [p]It's [b]MakeRoom Monday[/b]! (let’s see if we can make this a tradition 🥰). I’ve been working on a new update that’s live today, and I’m really excited to share it with you. It tackles one of the most requested features (3D model exporting) but also comes with a ton of new items, changes, improvements and fixes. Let's dive in![/p][p][/p][h2]3D Exporting[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/22ca7b397dda88856ad056c990a87e11279966dd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can now save a 3D model of any object you’ve made. Just open the menu and choose [i]“Export 3D model”[/i] This will give you three files:[/p][list][*][p][b]OBJ[/b] file - the main model, which you can open in other software (like the freely available 3D modeling software Blender)[/p][/*][*][p][b]MTL[/b] file - holds details about the materials used[/p][/*][*][p][b]PNG[/b] file - a texture map that adds color to your model[/p][/*][/list][p]Anything you export is yours to use however you like, in any of your projects.[/p][p][/p][h2]Object editor improvements[/h2][p][/p][p]The object editor just got some handy upgrades. You can now align the grid to your selected object, perfect for editing on slopes or at different angles. Grid snapping can now be turned off entirely for finer control, an often requested feature from the community![/p][p][/p][p]There’s also a new toggle to choose whether selecting an object opens the toolbar or go straight to the gizmo. Some changes were made to the gizmo that makes grabbing handles, and rotation, a lot easier now.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Items[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/c8f9db615796a643d43c5ebde080a0a8c961d755.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update also comes with 40 new items including new primitives for use in custom objects plus hanging and laying herbs, a mortar and pestle, vases, and more![/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback and ideas are important to make MakeRoom even better in the future, feel free to keep posting them - I'll be reading them all! The full changelog can be found below:[/p][p][/p][p][b]New features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Export custom objects as 3D models[/p][/*][*][p]Align grid to the selected object in custom mode[/p][/*][*][p]Disable grid snapping in custom mode[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle between gizmo and toolbar in custom mode[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes & improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Workshop:[/b] Added link and copy-to-clipboard after upload[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Workshop:[/b] Side panel closes automatically after upload[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] Grid shows front arrow indicator[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] Grid selection now affects rotation[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] Improved rotation drag threshold[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] Enlarged gizmo handle margins for easier use[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mode:[/b] Renamed “grid size” to “snap size”[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad:[/b] Added vertical movement controls (triggers)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad:[/b] Cleaning cursor icons now display[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad:[/b] Virtual cursor displays above all elements[/p][/*][*][p][b]Help screen:[/b] Added vertical movement instructions[/p][/*][*][p][b]Help screen:[/b] Improved layout[/p][/*][*][p][b]Help screen:[/b] Improved input icons[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new colors to the color palette [i](teal, peach and mauve)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Improved visuals of the island[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed rendering issues with complex custom models[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wall overlap in large rooms[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected wall heights in large rooms[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed reversed textures on placeable walls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed objects sticking to background in object editor[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed curtains not auto-adjusting notes.title: Update 2 (Color wheel, and more!)
notes.content: [p]Hello again! I've worked hard on another update for MakeRoom based on your feedback and comments ✨ This update adds new features, improvements, fixes and there's a bunch of new items. Let's dive right in![/p][p][/p][h2]Color wheel[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/4c9490510c6efda9f3cae20a794b2aafd89ffdb9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]One of the most requested features from the community is here: the color wheel! With it, you can pick any color you’d like for objects, walls, floors, and the background. It also includes HEX input and even remembers your recent selections. Plus, in the options menu you can now choose whether the palette or the wheel shows by default.[/p][p][/p][h2]Vertical object movement[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/52d5f135c74e2c0fa1315a42a5b091b8ce1abcba.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can now hold [b]Shift[/b] while scrolling to move an object vertically, making it much easier to build extra floors or place items at different heights. Wall-mounted objects can also be rotated when they’re not mounted, giving you more flexibility when decorating.[/p][p][/p][h2]New items[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/ca8f7c68f9ce8138bd8c0f578a1f9baa4197672e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update also adds 30 new items including narrow kitchen cabinets, various coffee shop signs, awnings, a record player, park bench, vanity table and more plushies![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for all the feedback and reviews, they're help a lot to bring these updates and include as many improvements as possible. Any ideas or requests are welcome, so feel free to post them. The full changelog can be found below:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Additions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Color wheel with last-used color memory and toggle in options[/p][/*][*][p]Vertical placement movement (hold SHIFT and scroll)[/p][/*][*][p]Two new samples were adding (Apothecary Corner & Thrift Shop)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes & improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Wall-mounted objects can be rotated when unmounted[/p][/*][*][p]Wall-mounted objects now mount to every vertical surface[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Workshop thumbnails increased to 1024×[/p][/*][*][p]Audio settings apply instantly[/p][/*][*][p]Sample loading optimized[/p][/*][*][p]Higher resolution sleeping effect[/p][/*][*][p]Improved smoke visuals[/p][/*][*][p]“Load” menu button renamed to “Open”[/p][/*][*][p]Light switches and outlets moved from “Wall Decoration” to “Electronics”[/p][/*][*][p]Changed “Chairs” category to “Chairs & Benches”[/p][/*][*][p]Camper van icon updated[/p][/*][*][p]Precise rotation hotkey changed from SHIFT to CTRL[/p][/*][*][p]Changed brown color tints slightly[/p][/*][*][p]Changed effect object icons[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Object placement cancels correctly when returning to menu[/p][/*][*][p]Backspace no longer triggers undo during text entry[/p][/*][*][p]Music skipping issue resolved[/p][/*][*][p]Page browsing fixed when opening Workshop items[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue no longer overlaps buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Seagull flying speed corrected[/p][/*][*][p]“Back to menu” button hidden during photography/Workshop mode[/p][/*][*][p]Ambience notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h3]Objects[/h3]

The game will launch with over 1,000 different objects. Kitchens, sofas, clutter, carpets, pets, and more! After the launch of the game, more content will be added through free updates. You can look forward to themed sets, seasonal decorations, and community-inspired designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/82ca4ad36285678323a806a0e8794872eace3e90.png[/img]

[h3]Objectives[/h3]

Currently the game contains 10 objectives. Objectives range from building a cat café to helping a vampire create a lair! These objectives will guide you through the game and reward you with new content. Post-launch, additional objectives will be introduced.

[h3]Object Creator[/h3]

The included object creator allows everyone to design their own furniture and decorations. Using a variety of pre-made blocks, you can craft unique items and share them with the community through Steam Workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/1043adccb72cf289df4449b88e87a3a31451ca89.png[/img]

[h3]Steam Workshop[/h3]

Sharing is at the heart of the game! You can upload and download custom-made rooms and furniture via Steam Workshop. Browse thousands of user-created designs, get inspired, and personalize your space with handcrafted pieces from fellow decorators.

[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]

For those who love a challenge, the game includes a variety of Steam Achievements to unlock. From decorating your first room to completing all objectives.

[h3]Steam Deck™ support[/h3]

We’re excited to confirm full support for the Steam Deck™! The game has been optimized for handheld play, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience whether you're at home or on the go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375437/9d7489d15c9f283d6c4a326283fbaa81912d713b.png[/img]

[h3]Release date[/h3]

Unfortunately at this point it's still a bit hard to give a release date for the game. While a lot has been completed (nearly 90%!) there's still stuff to do. Thanks for your patience!
